verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document @mentions, shared candidate notes, team tasks, or visibility rules that scope sensitive feedback in Workable. The closest items, a candidate-rating API endpoint and a permission_sets listing endpoint, are adjacent API primitives, not documented collaboration or feedback-scoping features, so they earn no credit.
